annotations.title: Record a wake word in your own voice

description: Free, optional, recommended: returns Ania’s page where the person says the wake phrase several times in their own voice (~5 min, guided), so the trained model wakes more reliably for them. Afterwards create_wake_word with the SAME phrase and language pays for that same order and trains with the recordings. Without it, training is 100% synthetic.

language.description: Always pass it: the language the user is writing in right now, as a BCP-47 tag (e.g. 'en', 'en-US', 'pt-BR', 'es'), not the app's interface language. Replies, prices and the card follow it.

phrase.description: The wake phrase the user chose (checked like quote_wake_word).

wake_language.description: Language the wake word is spoken in (what the model listens for): en-US or pt-BR.

name: record_wake_word
